 THIS APPEAL COMING ON FOR ADMISSION THIS DAY, THE  COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 CORAM: THE HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SHIVASHANKAR AMARANNAVAR  -2-  NC: 2024:KHC-D:13132  MFA No. 100643 of 2014  ORAL JUDGMENT
This appeal is filed by the claimant seeking enhancement of compensation as awarded by the Tribunal in judgment dated 09.01.2014 passed by the learned Member MACT-II, Bagalkot, in MVC No.452/2012.

2. Brief facts of the appellant's case are that, on 27.01.2012 while the appellant was returning home on his bicycle on Bagalkot-Lokapur PWD road on extreme left side, at that time, when he was near Umesh Meti complex of Gaddanakeri cross, at about 4:00pm, the rider of the motorcycle bearing registration No.KA.29.U.3137 drove the same in a rash and negligent manner and dashed against the claimant and as a result, he sustained injuries.
He was shifted to Dr. Kerudi Hospital, Bagalkot where he took treatment.
Hence, the claimant filed a petition seeking compensation.

The Tribunal after recording evidence and on appreciating the oral and NC: 2024:KHC-D:13132 documentary evidence on record has awarded compensation as under:

3. The appellant/claimant seeking enhancement of the compensation as awarded by the Tribunal, has filed this appeal.

4. Heard the learned counsel for the appellant and the learned counsel for respondent No.2- insurance company.
5.

Learned counsel for the appellant would contend that the Doctor who examined the injured/claimant has been examined as PW.3 and he has stated that the injured has sustained 25%
disability to the whole body and the Tribunal has ignored the said evidence.

He contends that the Hanamappa Sagarappa@Bhimappa Maradi vs Ameer Durgappa Bhovi on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/170234787/

sentences.text: The Tribunal has not awarded compensation towards attendant charges, loss of income during laid up period, food and nourishment and loss of amenities.
With this, he prayed to allow the appeal.
6. Learned counsel for the respondent No.2 would contend that the compensation awarded by the Tribunal is just and proper.
With this, he prayed to dismiss the appeal.
7. Having heard the learned counsel, the Court has perused the impugned judgment and the trial Court records.
8. It is not in dispute that the accident occurred in the year 2012 and the claimant was aged 65 years.

The Doctor, who treated the injured, has been examined as PW.3 and he has deposed that the NC:
2024:KHC-D:13132 injured has sustained 25% disability to the whole body.
The Tribunal has ignored the said evidence.
The Tribunal ought to have taken at least the disability to the whole body at 10%.
As per the chart prepared by the Legal Services Authority for settlement of disputes before the Lok Adalat, notional income fixed for the year 2012 is Rs.6,500/- per month.
Therefore, the appellant/claimant is entitled to compensation under loss of future earnings in a sum of Rs.54,600/- (Rs.6,500/-x12x7x10%).

The Tribunal has rightly awarded a sum of Rs.40,000/-
towards pain and suffering and a sum of Rs.30,000/- towards medical expenses.
The appellant/claimant was admitted in the hospital for three days and therefore, he is entitled to attendant charges in a sum of Rs.5,000/-.
The Tribunal has not awarded any amount towards loss of income during laid up period.
The appellant is entitled to a sum of Rs.13,000/- (Rs.6,500 x 2 months) towards loss of NC: 2024:KHC-D:13132 income during laid up period.

Considering the nature of injuries and age of the injured, he is entitled to a sum of Rs.10,000/- towards food,
nourishment and transportation charges and a sum of Rs.25,000/- towards loss of amenities.
9. In view of the above, the appellant/claimant is entitled to compensation as under:

11. In the result, the following NC: 2024:KHC-D:13132 ORDER
The appeal is allowed in part.
The judgment and award dated 09.01.2014 passed by the learned Member MACT-II, Bagalkot, in MVC No.452/2012 is modified.

The appellant-claimant is entitled to total compensation of Rs.1,77,600/-
with interest at 6% per annum from the date of petition till realization.

Respondent No.2-insurance company shall deposit the compensation amount with interest within a period of six weeks from the date of receipt of certified copy of this judgment including the amount already deposited.
The appellant is entitled to release of entire compensation amount.
Draw the award accordingly.
